# RecordingBean / 录音豆

> Unofficial self-hosted D3200 / soundcore Work recorder sync for HarmonyOS, Android, and iOS. Native clients transfer recordings to a self-hosted Python server; optional NVIDIA NIM or compatible ASR, LLM summarization, and Feishu / Lark Docs publishing run as separate stages. This is not a public API or an official vendor product.

Keywords: D3200 recorder, soundcore Work, 飞书录音豆, self-hosted recorder sync, audio transcription, speech-to-text, meeting notes, NVIDIA NIM ASR, Feishu Docs, Lark Docs, HarmonyOS, Android, iOS.

Common questions: How do I sync D3200 recordings to my own server? Can NVIDIA NIM transcribe soundcore Work audio? How do I publish a transcript to Feishu? Can a browser replace the native recorder app?

## Important boundaries

- Device originals remain on the D3200. Phone audio is cleaned only after a matching durable cloud receipt.
- The cloud service is single-user and requires its own HTTPS deployment and access token.
- Real provider calls, Feishu publication, long recordings, live latency, and backup recovery need separate verification.
- GitHub repository visibility controls who can read these files. This index helps agents navigate the project; it does not guarantee search-engine or AI-answer inclusion.
